description: This file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel, specifically testing the consistency of document object types, nested value classes, metadata creation, and parent-child references within document objects.

classes.name: ConsistenceTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests to verify the integrity and consistency of document object types and their related metadata in the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: GetAllDocumentObjectTypes
methods.description: Returns all non-abstract subclasses of DocumentObject from the assembly.

methods.name: Check_all_Values_classes
methods.description: Checks that each DocumentObject type has a nested Values class with correct attributes.

methods.name: Create_all_Metas_and_check_ValueDescriptors
methods.description: Creates instances of DocumentObject types and verifies their meta information and value descriptors.

methods.name: Test_DocumentSelfSectionAndParentReferences
methods.description: Verifies that document elements correctly reference their parent document and section objects.

methods.name: CheckParentReferences
methods.description: Recursively checks that each DocumentObject's parent references are correct.
